rule: Demands guide descriptive research design. Registration only — no causal model, no baseline index, no new panel.

demands.name: ar_county_turnout_source_inventory
demands.question: Which Arkansas county presidential/midterm/primary/local/school-board/initiative turnout series exist for 2000–2024, and in what formats?

demands.name: turnout_level_volatility_persistence
demands.question: Can we compute county participation trend, volatility, and engagement persistence across cycles?

demands.name: structure_overlay_join
demands.question: Can NASS farm structure, FDIC banking, HRSA/HPSA, ACS/education/demography, and journalism coverage be joined to the county participation panel without proxy abuse?

demands.name: local_election_and_school_board_gaps
demands.question: Where are local and school-board turnout series missing or non-comparable across Arkansas counties?

demands.name: co_travel_descriptive_maps
demands.question: Which structure variables travel together with turnout level/stability — descriptively, with alternative explanations listed?

demands.name: trust_volunteerism_resilience_measures
demands.question: What survey/admin measures can stand in for civic trust, volunteerism, and resilience without inventing a baseline Community Health Index?

demands.name: hyp126_environment_contrast
demands.question: Do stronger local ownership / media / civic-institution environments show higher or more stable turnout than weaker ones?

demands.name: hyp127_adult_baseline_control
demands.question: What adult civic-structure baselines should control youth-suffrage case interpretation (MD/Newark/etc.)?

demands.name: hyp125_finance_participation_covariates
demands.question: How do local campaign-finance locality/competition measures covary with county participation patterns?

demands.name: decline_and_renewal_lead_indicators
demands.question: What structure shifts appear before civic decline or renewal in the county time series?
